steps.title: Buɗe shafin token daga Leafen
steps.caption: A cikin Leafen, “Buɗe shafin token na Notion” yana buɗe kayan aikin masu haɓakawa na Notion a sabon shafi.

steps.title: Ƙirƙira haɗi
steps.caption: A app.notion.com/developers/connections (Haɗin masu haɓakawa a cikin kayan aikin masu haɓakawa na Notion), danna “Sabon haɗi”.

steps.title: Ba shi suna sannan ƙirƙira shi
steps.caption: Ba shi suna a “Sunan haɗi”, kamar Leafen, bar “Token na API” sannan danna “Ƙirƙira haɗi”.

steps.title: Zaɓi shafukan da za a motsa
steps.caption: A cikin “Damar abun ciki” na haɗin, danna “Gyara damar shiga”, zaɓi manyan shafukan da za a motsa sannan danna “Ajiye”.

steps.title: Kwafi token ɗin API
steps.caption: A cikin “Tsari”, duba cewa an yi wa “Karanta abun ciki” alama sannan kwafi token ɗin (ntn_…) da ke gefen “Token na API”.

steps.title: Saka token ɗin cikin Leafen
steps.caption: Komawa cikin Leafen, liƙa token ɗin a cikin filin “Token na API na Notion” sannan danna “Ajiye token”.

steps.title: Zaɓi abin da za a motsa
steps.caption: Zaɓi shafuka da rumbun bayanai da za a motsa daga abin da haɗin ya kai. Bincike yana samun shafuka masu zurfi kuma.

screen.modalLead: Haɗi yana ba manhajoji, wakilai da hanyoyin aiki damar shiga Notion. Yana iya rufe wurin aiki ɗaya ko da yawa.
screen.apiTokenDesc: Tabbataccen token ɗin API na wurin aiki ɗaya, wanda masu aiki tare ke rabawa, yana da nasa saitunan samun dama. Ba za a iya saka shi a Marketplace ba.
screen.oauthDesc: OAuth 2.0 na kowane mai amfani, yana isa kawai ga abin da mai amfani da ya shiga zai iya. Yana aiki a tsakanin wuraren aiki kuma ana iya saka shi a Marketplace.
screen.terms: Ƙirƙirar haɗi yana nufin karɓar Sharuɗɗan Masu Haɓakawa na Notion.
screen.contentAccessDesc: Shafuka da database da wannan haɗin zai iya amfani da su
screen.pageAccessDesc: Saita shafukan da wannan haɗin zai iya isa. Ana iya ƙara shafukan da ba a haɗa su ba ta hanyar bincike.
screen.tokenSectionDesc: Buƙatun API zuwa wannan wurin aiki suna tabbatar da asali da wannan taken. Duk wanda ya riƙe shi zai iya yin aiki a matsayin wannan haɗin, don haka a ɓoye shi.
screen.capabilitiesDesc: Abin da wannan haɗin zai iya yi idan an kira shi da token ɗin API nasa
screen.readContentDesc: Duba shafukan da ke akwai da shigarwar database.

shows: Yadda ake ƙirƙirar token ɗin Notion da ba da shi ga Leafen
